_meta.doc: Source of truth for every tunable parameter in meme_sniper. Edit directly (file watcher reloads on mtime change) OR write natural-language directive to json_relay/sniper_meeting.json. Hardcoded floors (bonded dexId, freeze/mint authority null) live in code, not here — they are never tunable.

TRENDING_TICK_ACTIVE_SECONDS.description: Trending boosts scanner interval during active hours

history.reason: code default moved; reference field corrected. The live `value` was NOT changed.

code_default_drift.note: the code's default changed and this file was carrying the old one. The LOOP READS THIS FILE's `value`, so the new code default is NOT in effect. `code_default` has been corrected to the current code default so `value` now reads honestly as an override; `value` itself was NOT touched. If this knob was never hand-tuned, the value in effect is a stale default nobody chose - promote it deliberately (default_promotion) rather than assuming the const is live.

DEX_PAID_WATCH_TICK_S.description: How often to re-check socially-thin tokens that paid for dex_paid status

META_REFRESH_INTERVAL_S.description: How often to recompute the current dominant meta from trending tracks

MISSED_RUNNER_AUTOPSY_TICK_S.description: How often to scan for missed runners (tokens we filtered that ran 2x+)

history.by: owner-approved cadence change (missed-runner analysis 4h -> 90 min; per-mint report cooldown keeps 4h)

SCANNER_PAUSED.description: Pause the main scanner loop. New bonded tokens will not generate packets.

TRENDING_PAUSED.description: Pause the trending scanner loop (boosted tokens scan)

WATCHLIST_RECHECK_PAUSED.description: Pause watchlist rechecks. Existing watchlist entries stay but no recheck packets

DEX_PAID_MONITOR_PAUSED.description: Pause dex_paid monitoring of socially-thin tokens

MISSED_RUNNER_AUTOPSY_PAUSED.description: Pause the missed runner autopsy loop

META_REFRESH_PAUSED.description: Pause meta dominance recomputation. Existing meta state stays current.

WALLET_TRACKER_PAUSED.description: Pause the owner observer wallet polling

PACKET_TTL_PAUSED.description: Pause the packet TTL janitor that archives idle inbox packets

MCAP_FLOOR_USD.description: Sole filter for new bonded tokens. Below this, no packet is built.

WATCHLIST_RUNNER_THRESHOLD.description: Mcap multiplier from scan_mcap that triggers a runner_alert packet

TRENDING_HOLD_THRESHOLD_HOURS.description: How long a token must stay in top 10 trending to qualify as a hold candidate

EDGE_LIQ_MIN_USD.description: SOFT / INFO ONLY — liquidity does NOT gate anything. A1 (2026-08-08) took liq off the hard-gate path after TOAD missed on a $1.4K shortfall and printed ~143x. This is the low edge of a legacy autopsy reference band, kept so historical comparisons line up. The ONLY hard pre-packet floor in this bot is MCAP_FLOOR_USD. Thin liquidity is an exit-physics question for the agent, not a veto.

history.reason: TOAD 2026-08-08 neutralize EDGE_LIQ; sole hard floor MCAP_FLOOR 10k
the owner: 1k too low, set EDGE_LIQ_MIN to 8k

EDGE_LIQ_MAX_USD.description: SOFT / INFO ONLY — the upper edge of the same legacy autopsy reference band. Does not gate. A token above this band is not 'too late' by rule — it is a different setup, and the agent grades it.

history.reason: TOAD 2026-08-08 neutralize EDGE_LIQ; sole hard floor MCAP_FLOOR 10k

EDGE_MCAP_MIN_USD.description: ADVISORY — does not drop the token. Minimum mcap stamped on the owner's edge filter

EDGE_MCAP_MAX_USD.description: ADVISORY — does not drop the token. Maximum mcap for the edge stamp. Above this is not an auto-skip.

EDGE_VOL_LIQ_RATIO_MIN.description: ADVISORY — does not drop the token. Minimum volume:liquidity ratio is a stamp. Below this is not a kill.

BRAIN_NARRATIVE_ENABLED.description: Whether to call synthesize_narrative_intelligence on each packet. Disable to skip LLM narrative summary and save compute.

BRAIN_PATTERN_LLM_ENABLED.description: Whether to call llm_name_novel_pattern when chart matches no known pattern. Disable to skip LLM pattern naming, fall back to heuristic only.

BRAIN_VISION_ENABLED.description: Whether to run vision analysis on chart PNGs. Disable to skip vision compute on chart packets.

CHART_BUILD_ENABLED.description: Whether to render chart PNGs at all. Disable to skip chart_request handling entirely.

MEETING_POLL_INTERVAL_S.description: How often meeting_watcher_loop checks for new directives via file-presence poll (os.path.exists). The cheap part since no file = zero work. Lower = faster directive response, higher = lighter on the box.

MEETING_LOW_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD.description: Confidence floor for auto-applying a directive. Below this, status downgrades to clarification_needed and the owner is asked to rephrase.

WALLET_FLOOR_SOL.description: Wallet floor. Scanner/trending/watchlist/dex_paid/missed_runner LOOPS PAUSE when wallet ≤ this. Sells stay active. 0.05 SOL is enough to submit a sell tx. Raise if you want more buy-side headroom; lower at your own risk.

HOLDERS_MIN_COUNT.description: ADVISORY — does not drop the token. Minimum holder count surfaced for the agent; brand-new launches are not filtered out. real community. Set to 0 to disable.

TOP10_MAX_PCT.description: ADVISORY — does not drop or block the packet. Top-10 concentration is flagged if top-10 own MORE than this % of supply. Lower is stricter on whale concentration; raise to 70+ to be permissive with fresh tokens.

DEV_MAX_HOLDING_PCT.description: Maximum % of supply the deployer wallet can hold. The owner's edge: an outsized deployer holding is a frequent rug signal.

TIME_BONDED_MIN_MINUTES.description: ADVISORY — does not drop the token. Time since migration to a real DEX is stamped, not skipped. Reference for the insider-sniping launch chaos window. Set to 0 to disable.

TIME_BONDED_MAX_MINUTES.description: ADVISORY — does not drop the token. Maximum time since bonding, in minutes. Past the typical runner window is a stamp, not a skip. Raise toward 10080 (7d) for longer-tail plays.

LP_LOCKED_MIN_PCT.description: Minimum % of LP that must be locked per rugcheck. ADVISORY ONLY — the bonded dexId hardcoded floor is what enforces 'graduated to real DEX.' Set to 90 or 100 for strict; 0 = no filter.

VOL_LIQ_5M_MIN.description: Minimum vol_5m / liq ratio. Useful for filtering on fresh activity right now. 0 = no filter; try 0.5+ for active-only.

VOL_LIQ_1H_MIN.description: Minimum vol_1h / liq ratio — wants some volume in the last hour. EDGE_VOL_LIQ_RATIO_MIN covers 24h; this covers the recent hour. 0 = no filter.

PRICE_CHANGE_5M_MIN.description: Block tokens whose 5min price change is below this. Default -50% (filter out tokens crashing in real-time). Raise to 0 for 'only pumping' filter.

PRICE_CHANGE_24H_MIN.description: Block tokens whose 24h price change is below this. Default -90% (filter out near-dead tokens). Raise for stronger momentum filter.

TWITTER_FOLLOWERS_MIN.description: Minimum X (Twitter) follower count on the token's official X account. 0 = no filter.

TELEGRAM_MEMBERS_MIN.description: Minimum Telegram member count for the token. 0 = no filter.

X_ACCOUNT_AGE_MIN_DAYS.description: Minimum age of the X account in days. 0 = no filter; set to 7+ to filter out 'freshly created' shill accounts.

REQUIRE_META_ALIGNMENT.description: If True, skip tokens whose narrative is NOT aligned with the current dominant meta. Default False (off) — sniper still surfaces non-meta tokens.

META_ALIGNMENT_WEIGHT.description: Edge-score multiplier for meta-aligned tokens. 1.0 = no bonus; raise to 1.5+ to boost meta-aligned scores.

WATCHLIST_RUNNER_TIER2_X.description: Tier-2 runner alert threshold (more urgent). Mcap multiplier vs scan_mcap that triggers a tier-2 runner_alert.

EDGE_PRICE_CHANGE_1H_MIN.description: Edge filter minimum 1h price change. Tokens below this fail the price_change_1h_pos gate; at 0 that means negative 1h moves are excluded.

history.reason: runner-vs-rug: price_change_1h_pos kills 100% real runners vs 50% rugs; allow mild -5% 1h retrace so runners clear edge; single-knob isolated window test
meeting no-op at -5; discovery still rejects 53% runners vs 44% rugs on price_change_1h_pos; one-knob relax to -15 for pullback entries

DYNAMIC_SIZE_CAP_ENABLED.description: If True, position-size cap ratchets up with wallet growth (1→2→4→8→16 SOL). If False, cap freezes at SIZE_CAP_BASE_SOL.

SIZE_CAP_BASE_SOL.description: Position-size cap when wallet = 1x anchor. Also the floor when DYNAMIC_SIZE_CAP_ENABLED=False.

SIZE_CAP_TIER1_SOL.description: Tier-1 position-size cap (kicks in at SIZE_CAP_TIER1_MULTIPLIER × anchor).

SIZE_CAP_TIER4_SOL.description: Tier-4 position-size cap (was implicit cap at tier-3 in v13.0).

SIZE_CAP_TIER1_MULTIPLIER.description: Wallet multiplier vs anchor at which the tier-1 cap kicks in — once the wallet has grown by this factor, size caps step up.

SIZE_CAP_TIER2_MULTIPLIER.description: Wallet multiplier vs anchor at which the tier-2 cap kicks in.

SIZE_CAP_TIER3_MULTIPLIER.description: Wallet multiplier vs anchor at which the tier-3 cap kicks in.

SIZE_CAP_TIER4_MULTIPLIER.description: Wallet multiplier vs anchor at which the tier-4 cap kicks in.

DEFAULT_MAX_HOLD_MINUTES.description: Default max-hold time for positions, in minutes, when a signal doesn't specify max_hold_hours. Hold-mode positions still override this with their own max_hold_hours param.

history.reason: reconcile 360->240 (code const 2026-07-30; filter was still old)

DEFAULT_BREAKEVEN_MOVE_MINUTES.description: If a position hasn't moved at least ±2% from entry in this many minutes, suggest exit — 'dead in the water', no thesis activation. Set to 0 to disable.

history.reason: reconcile 30->20 (code const 2026-07-30; filter was still old)

DEFAULT_FLAT_PRICE_EXIT_MINUTES.description: Stricter flatness gate. If price stays within ±0.5% of entry for this many continuous minutes, suggest exit. Set to 0 to disable.

DEFAULT_DRAWDOWN_VELOCITY_EXIT_PCT_PER_M.description: Drawdown velocity panic-suggest exit. If a position is losing faster than this %/min over a 5min window, fire a panic_sell suggestion (the agent still decides).

RUG_COLLAPSE_PCT.description: A watched scanned coin that drops this % from its peak within 48h of scan gets fingerprinted as a rug (feeds archetype clustering). Dynamic so you can catch slow bleeds later, not just 90% one-clicks.

ARCHETYPE_MIN_CLUSTER.description: A fingerprint cluster must reach this many members before it surfaces as a named archetype review packet. Below this it clusters silently. Rug calls are heavier than chart-shape calls, so this sits above the pattern threshold of 3.

The live number is this knob's `value` — deliberately not repeated here. A caption that names a number goes stale the first time the number moves and then argues with the knob it describes (FIX 3, 2026-08-15). Change history lives in the knob's `history` array.
